description: The plot illustrates the relationship between model configurations and metric scores. The x-axis is labeled “Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset” and displays categorical values representing different model configurations: “Full model w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 57 to 66, with tick labels at intervals of 2.  A blue line with circular markers represents “Precision”, starting at approximately 65.78 at “Full model w/o Augmentation” and decreasing to 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. An orange line with square markers represents “Recall”, beginning at 62.63 at “Full model w/o Augmentation” and declining to 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. A purple line with diamond markers represents “F1-score”, starting at 64.06 at “Full model w/o Augmentation”, decreasing to 62.22 at “w/o Prompt”, then to 61.06 at “w/o Augmentation”, increasing to 62.63 at “w/o Attention”, and finally decreasing to 59.67 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”.
